title: Interlineary
summary: INTERLIN'EARY, a. [inter and linear.] Written between lines before written or printed. INTERLIN'EARY, n. A book having insertions between the leaves.

inlines.v: INTERLIN'EARY, a. [inter and linear.] Written between lines before written or printed. INTERLIN'EARY, n. A book having insertions between the leaves.
